name_rule: Keep Latin-script names as written; transliterate others.
style_guide: Use a formal legal register. Translate faithfully and completely; never add, explain, summarise or complete text. Keep the source order and structure. Keep identifiers (ID, tax, serial and reference numbers, verification codes, URLs, emails, hashes) exactly as written. Keep dates and numbers as written in the source unless the job asks to localise them. Use Italian legal register. Notes: // Timbro: ... // , // Firma // .

labels.repeated_notes_heading: Timbri e firme presenti su tutte le pagine
